task: Attribution diagnostics on frozen R9 merged inputs, not optimization or author replication certification
data_source: guosheng_cross_review_20261114.compare_evidence.latest_local + r6_states, merged signal including disputed old LPR, no new input collection

factorial.T: 0 all six assets, 1 observed six-regime selected basket
factorial.W: 0 equal capital, 1 equal risk contributions using 63 joint valid completed sessions
factorial.E: 0 month first session; 1 month first + observed macro basket change, identical event calendar for static and timed arms

cash_policy: Unqualified original asset slots stay in zero-return cash; qualified slot budget allocated by EW or ERC; qualification requires own and joint 63 actual eligible observations. Calendar used is shared across experimental arms, not performance selected.
execution: Existing fractional next-close amount engine for long history; existing original-price integer-share next-open engine for recent ETF quotes; cannot mix their results. Sale proceeds unavailable for same-session new buys; one subsequent buy attempt.
extra_controls: equal-capital average of all six stage-basket ERC targets, no stage selection (not claimed as author's top-level ERC)
same historical mean exposure with monthly rebalancing: ex-post explanatory comparator, never tradable ex-ante benchmark
zero-transaction-fee replay of fixed rules, no cash-settlement relaxation
ex-post downside-only volatility matching to V12 daily returns, diagnostic only, not optimized strategy
attribution: Daily asset money P&L and fee contribution exactly linked using log(1+r)/r. Group by asset, year, latest decision stage. Also decompose amount P&L into average beginning-of-day exposure and varying-weight residual; this is accounting, not causal alpha. Factorial Shapley and interaction terms from all fixed arms.
risk: Net CAGR, daily sample volatility sqrt252, MDD with initial capital, recovery duration, 3/5 calendar-year rolling windows, annual and fixed non-overlapping subperiods, turnover and cost. Actual quote period reports cumulative returns prominently.
falsifiers: Timing net advantage not positive versus same-pool no-timing controls after risk diagnostic and stricter availability: cannot attribute robust excess to timing
ERC advantage comes only from changed total risk: describe as risk management rather than return alpha
Switching gain confined to few historical events or sign reverses in constrained data: no universal frequency superiority
P&L attribution fails exact equity reconciliation: stop interpretation
scope: Uses targeted QSA-35/37/38/39/40/44/45 and EXT-14/18/19/27/39/51 plus research and Bayesian-thinking workflows. Not a completed 70-rule or full QSA audit. Same assistant participated in earlier research: self-review, not independent blind review.
writes: Only this isolated R10 directory; no network, no trade accounts, no installation, no edits to prior inputs/strategies. All failures retained.
